scope: Frozen round40 update from checkpoint39; no new games, RL overrides, model changes or promoted checkpoints.
primary_timing_rule: Compare the two direct-copy+cache replays with controls having identical sample/accepted/rejected/critic/optimizer work counts. Preserve the extra-retry control separately.
policy_guard_note: Every policy output is recomputed after proposals; only frozen inputs are cached. Any GPU-dependent retry variation remains visible. Defaults are unchanged.
limitations: One frozen update on one RTX4090; repetitions measure runtime, not independent learning trials.
Individual guard retries may vary with FP32 GPU execution; compare matching-work cases as well as all trials.
Inputs/padding/order match exactly; GPU gradients and final states need not be bitwise identical, including A/A controls.
Reported temporary file sizes are logical backing bytes; mappings also consume reclaimable OS page cache beyond the unchanged explicit512MiB rollout cache.
Setup, initial data scan, cache construction and cleanup are included in full update timings.
